subject.title: Feature: TTS delivery mode option — separate text + voice messages on Telegram

question: Should OpenClaw add a public Telegram TTS delivery policy for separate text-plus-voice delivery, and should that policy be global under `messages.tts` or Telegram/channel-specific?
rationale: The source-level UX problem is real, but adding a delivery selector creates a new public config/API contract and overlaps captioned-final and voice-only TTS directions.

options.title: Approve a narrow delivery policy
options.body: Define a backward-compatible delivery mode with docs and tests for captioned/bundled versus separate Telegram behavior before implementation.

options.title: Standardize captioned delivery
options.body: Keep captioned voice as the supported default and document tagged/manual splitting plus overflow fallback instead of adding a selector.

options.title: Wait for captioned-final work
options.body: Defer this decision until the open captioned-final PR direction settles, then revisit how separate delivery should coexist.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow delivery policy
recommendation.body: Define a backward-compatible delivery mode with docs and tests for captioned/bundled versus separate Telegram behavior before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal spans both the TTS config surface and Telegram caption delivery behavior.
